inputs.resume_input_key: sha256(events file sha256 + events _done marker sha256 + day) per day

rules.early_endpoint: existing causal fade ruler: first fade onset strictly before session end, else the calendar terminal open; original owned shares, common exit fee
rules.early_endpoint_source: events feature_event_fade_ruler (same causal release expression as the owned_claim_replay 'fade' book); a stale fade book is refused, never used
rules.late_endpoint: reserved original slot budget, deployed only on the first +5% with no strictly-prior owned damage (history minus the coincident event flag) before 13:00, at the actual next open, quantity fixed from the causal completed mark (90% headroom), exit at the 15/30/60m ruler
rules.late_qualifier: feature_event_profit5 > 0 and feature_hist_count_damage - feature_event_damage <= 0 and t < 780
rules.budget: one admitted slot = one unit of admission cash budget
rules.entry_basis: early = sunk original admission (its entry fee was paid at the fill); late = fresh capital paying a buy fee at the qualifier open plus a sell fee at the exit
rules.unaffordable_gap: UNKNOWN, never resized and never financed
rules.insufficient_horizon: calendar-known insufficient horizon stands in cash (causal) and is decided before any mark, future open or funding read; any other missing qualification price or ruler exit is UNKNOWN and counted
rules.frontier: W(a) = a*W_early + (1-a)*W_late; break_even_a solves W(a) = cash
rules.break_even_domain: break_even_a is the raw analytic root, never clamped or optimized; both endpoints above (or below) cash puts it outside [0, 1], and in-domain crossings versus endpoint-cash equality are labeled explicitly

caveats: Descriptive capital-timing diagnostic, not validated EV and not a strategy verdict.
a = 0 is one endpoint measurement, never a replacement thesis; the frontier is linear by construction and no alpha grid or winning horizon is searched.
Late exits 15/30/60m are rulers reported independently; no horizon is preferred.
Qualification uses only past owned-path state; the admission roster is fixed and no future winner or liquidity is used as a gate.
Only discovery days are read; protected outcomes and FREEZE are never touched.
Open prices are modeled rulers, not quote/queue-certified fills.
